title: Synthesis Text
description: VERIFY-stage producer artifact. Output of synthesis-writer. Human-readable prose rendering of the panel_synthesis verdict, written for the director/record. check_synthesis_fidelity.py checks that the prose verdict is consistent with the structured panel_synthesis verdict (prose 'no concerns' vs structured BLOCK is flagged).

structured_verdict.description: copied verbatim from the panel_synthesis verdict; fidelity checker compares this against prose_verdict_word

prose_verdict_word.description: the verdict as written in the prose (e.g. 'approve', 'block', 'concerns', 'no issues'); fidelity checker flags mismatch with structured_verdict

body.description: full prose synthesis text written for the director; must accurately reflect all addressed and unaddressed blocks

addressed_blocks_summary.description: brief prose summaries of each addressed block (optional but recommended for traceability)

remaining_concerns.description: prose list of any remaining BLOCK/WARN items, to be consistent with unaddressed_blocks in panel_synthesis

from_synthesis_ref.description: reference to the panel_synthesis artifact this text derives from
